feeds.title: Houston Pet Talk
feeds.description: Houston PetTalk is a print and digital media that provides the number one source for all pet information, including events, news, pet care tips, human interest articles, local celebrities, and pet rescue.

feeds.title: Pet City Houston Blog
feeds.description: Check out our blog. It's filled with a bunch of tips and info to help you raise a happy and healthy pet family. We carry everything from fish, marine fish, reptiles, exotics, puppies, birds, hedgehogs, bunnies, ferrets, and so much more. If you are looking for unique items for your dog, fish or reptiles, then Pet City Houston is the store for you.

feeds.title: Nourish Pet Care Blog
feeds.description: With over 23 years of experience in Veterinary Medicine, Nourish Pet Care can help you find holistic solutions coupled with nutrition to improve and sustain your pets' health. Our Luxury Cat Boarding service sets the gold standard for boarding in the Houston, TX area! Our blog isyour source for important information on pet care, health, tips and more!

feeds.title: Beyond the Dog Blog
feeds.description: This is Dr. Savage's Science-based and experience driven Dog Training blog. Beyond the Dog is a team of individuals passionate about improving the lives of dogs through science-based training. We strive to develop training programs that improve the lives of dogs and their owners utilizing the latest research in behavioral science.

feeds.title: Meadowlake Pet Resort & Training Center Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest news and information from Meadowlake Pet Resort. Nested in the warm, natural confines of Houston, Texas, Meadowlake Pet Resort & Training Center is dedicated to providing the highest quality, healthiest, and most fun-loving care for pets and the parents who love them.

feeds.title: Houston Raw Pet Food Blog
feeds.description: Houston Raw Pet Food is one of the top raw pet food suppliers offering a wide variety of pet food across Texas and the nation. Find a collection of insightful guides and tips on ideal feeding behaviour and practices for pets in their blog.

feeds.title: HOUSTON PETSET Blog
feeds.description: Houston PetSet is dedicated to alleviating the homelessness and suffering of companion animals. Our mission is to end homelessness and suffering of companion animals and elevate their status in society. We envision a world where companion animals do not suffer and are valued by society. Explore our blog for tips and advice on petcare, pet health, news and more!

feeds.title: Houston Pet People Blog
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date with Houston Pet People happenings, pet care tips, and local recommendations from your pet's very best friend! Our goal is to get legs movin', tails waggin', and minds restin' (depending on their needs, of course!) so when you return home from work or vacation, you know your pet was safe spending time with his/her best friend.

feeds.title: Sunset Animal Hospital Blog
feeds.description: Sunset Animal Hospital is a full-service veterinary hospital and boarding facility that is conveniently open all day, every day. Their professional and courteous health care team aspires to excellence in medical quality and client service. They utilize the most cutting-edge knowledge, equipment, and techniques available to care for your pets and exceed your expectations. They recognize the bond between people and animals and thus treat pets as part of the family.

feeds.title: Sit Means Sit Dog Training Blog
feeds.description: View one of our many blog posts discussing dog training tips, tricks, and advice. Anything from dog parks in Houston to safety tips on raising your dog. We house the most experienced dog trainers dedicated to more than just new tricks, but investing in the most-well behaved dog you've ever seen! Our trainers share our beliefs in the loving and enduring relationship between a dog and their owner.

feeds.title: Bud Houston's Blog
feeds.description: I am a dog trainer and seminarist making something of a living teaching dog agility. This space will mostly be used to record my adventures in the dog agility world and to work through my theories of training and handling.

feeds.title: Houston Dog Mom
feeds.description: Feeling overwhelmed navigating Houston's dog scene? Tail wags and happy barks await at Houston Dog Mom! This one-stop shop caters to everything the discerning Houston Dog Mom needs to keep her furry friend flourishing. Whether you're seeking the perfect dog walker, scouting out reputable rescues, or whipping up delicious homemade treats, Houston Dog Mom serves as your ultimate resource guide.

feeds.title: Meyerland Animal Clinic Blog
feeds.description: Explore health and behavior advice for pet owners. Here, you will find a passionate team of animal lovers with diverse talents, skill sets, and backgrounds. But what truly makes this team special is how we work together and collaborate. This means that your pet will have a built-in healthcare network, second and third opinions, and access to medical professionals who are uniquely qualified to deal with a wide range of medical issues.

feeds.title: High Five Animal Training Blog
feeds.description: Dog and cat certified trainer and behavioral consultant sharing tips on training your dog or cat and solving pet behavior issues.

feeds.title: Jackson's Place Blog
feeds.description: Here are a bunch of cheerful, endearing and sometimes whimsical pet stories to make your day. Follow more updates from the blog to stay informed. Conveniently located in the heart of Houston, Jackson's Place is a cage-free daycare and boarding facility for dogs of all sizes.

feeds.title: Emancipet Blog
feeds.description: Access a library of trusted, reliable, bilingual and non-technical information about pet health. Emancipet has compiled a series of articles and other resources to provide relevant information related to your cat or dog's health. Emancipet is a nonprofit organization on a mission to make veterinary care affordable and accessible for everyone.

feeds.title: Animal Emergency Clinic North East Blog
feeds.description: The Animal Emergency Clinic North East is an emergency resource in Humble, Texas, open for pet owners 24/7, 365 days a year to complement area veterinarians' services when they are unavailable. Learn about pet insurance, pet toxins, senior pet recommendations, and other articles on educational veterinary topics to keep you pet safe and healthy.

feeds.title: Puptown Houston Blog
feeds.description: Dog trainers who work with Puptown Houston welcome your pup into their homes and their pack at our facility. Whether you are looking for obedience training, puppy training, service dog training, or private lessons, their dog trainers have the skills to meet your training needs. Read pet training tips, pet care, behavioral tips, and more!

feeds.title: Safari Veterinary Care Centers Blog
feeds.description: Safari Veterinary Care Centers is your one-stop solution for all your pet's needs. In 1984, Dr. Garner founded Safari with the idea of creating a veterinary hospital. They offer many services as Veterinary Dental Services, Regenerative Stem Cell Therapy, Pet Animal Rehabilitation, and many more. Their blog contains updates from their center, along with pet boarding, pet sitting, and health and safety tips.

feeds.title: Rollin' Vets Blog
feeds.description: Find awesome tips and tricks here that help keep your furry friends feeling their best. From tips on feeding your pets right to handling those sneaky vet visits, the Rollin' Vets blog's got your back. Rollin' Vets is a full-service mobile veterinary clinic on wheels serving the pets and families of the greater Houston area 5 days a week.
